entries.zh: 戾：凌虐、亏待（长上对下）。agrauiar el superior injustamente＝长官行事不义地亏待其属下；戾本义乖违、暴戾，此处取「上凌下」之义；亦通「乖戾、罪」。
entries.en: for the superior to wrong or oppress unjustly; perverse, harsh (li4)

entries.zh: 戾虐：残虐、苛虐（上对下的亏待）。西语以 agrauar 展开词头，戾虐合称虐待百姓之义。
entries.en: cruel oppression, harsh treatment by a superior (li4-nüe4)

entries.zh: 虐：残害、虐待。agrauiar, cargar a los subditos el superior＝长官把重担压给臣民，即横征暴虐之义。
entries.en: cruelty, to mistreat; the superior burdening his subjects (nüe4)

entries.zh: 虐民：虐害百姓。agrauiar a los vasallos＝亏待臣民，即官府苛虐于民。
entries.en: to oppress the people / subjects (nüe4-min2)

entries.zh: 磕着：冲撞、抵触而受亏。agrauiar en contrándose＝相撞而得罪于人，磕＝碰、撞，着＝碰上。
entries.en: to offend by clashing with, to bump into and wrong someone (kap-tioh)

entries.zh: 猖：猖獗、横暴。agrauiar 此处取猖狂肆虐之意。
entries.en: wild, rampant, violent (chang1)

entries.zh: 猖狂：猖狂无理、肆横。como atronado sin razón／sin oírla＝如雷霆轰然、无理且不听人言，即猖狂横行。
entries.en: wild and unbridled, raging without reason, refusing to listen (chang1-kuang2)

entries.zh: 控制：挟制、胁制。agrauiar menospreciando y desobedeciendo＝轻蔑并违抗，即以下挟上、以强凌弱之义（17 世纪「控制」多作挟制解）。
entries.en: to coerce, domineer over, holding down by contempt and disobedience (kong4-chhi4)
entries.notes: 「控制」今义与西语释义差异大，按 17 世纪「挟制」义释，属词义推断。

entries.zh: 恃顽：恃势顽抗、倚势欺人。agrauiar con confiança del favor de otro＝倚仗他人恩宠而行亏害。
entries.en: to wrong relying on another's backing, presumptuous defiance (shi4-wan2)

entries.zh: 屈害：屈害、陷害。屈＝冤屈，害＝加害；即构陷加害于人。
entries.en: to wrong and injure, to frame someone (chhit-hai7)

entries.zh: 屈东屈西：东家西家到处屈害，即四处亏待人。agrauiar a todo el mundo＝亏害普天下之人。
entries.en: to wrong everybody, here and there (chhit-tang-chhit-sai)
entries.notes: 「屈东屈西」为口语对举结构，依西语 a todo el mundo 释义。

entries.zh: 屈：屈、冤屈而加害；单字词头，泛指亏屈人之义。
entries.en: to wrong, to do injustice to (chhit4)

entries.zh: 狂暴：狂暴、骄横无礼。agrauiar con soberbia desatinadamente＝狂妄倨傲地凌人。
entries.en: arrogant violence, insolent fury (kuang5-pou7)

entries.zh: 触犯：触犯（法度）。agrauiar quebrando la palabra o las leyes＝背约或犯法，即触犯刑律、违背诺言。
entries.en: to offend, to violate (a promise or the law) (chhiok-hoan7)

entries.zh: 触怨：触怨、结怨。agrauiar aborreciendo＝以憎恶相加而致怨。
entries.en: to offend and provoke resentment (chhiok-oan7)

entries.zh: 触发：干犯冒上（下犯上）。agrauiar provocando el inferior a el superior＝下位者触怒上位者，触发＝冒犯激怒。
entries.en: to provoke, for an inferior to offend a superior (chhiok-hoat)

entries.zh: 侵犯：侵犯、擅入加害。agrauiar atrebido＝放胆冒犯，即侵凌越分而犯。
entries.en: to invade, to trespass upon, to encroach boldly (chhim-hoan7)

entries.zh: 横做：横行妄为。agrauiar＝蛮横行事，横做＝胡作非为、强横妄作。
entries.en: to act wildly and wrongfully, domineering conduct (hoaiN5-cho3)

entries.zh: 冤屈：冤屈。agrauiar con enemistad＝挟怨亏害人，使人蒙冤受屈。
entries.en: injustice, to wrong out of enmity (oan1-chhit4)

entries.zh: 冤枉：冤枉。agrauiar el enemigo＝冤枉仇家，即诬枉、委屈了人。
entries.en: to wrong, to accuse falsely (oan1-ong2)

entries.zh: 冤郁：冤屈郁结。agrauiar y ser agraviado＝亏害人与受亏害，冤郁＝受冤而心中郁结。
entries.en: grievance and pent-up resentment, wronged and grieving (oan1-ut4)
entries.notes: 西语释义为双向（亏害人且受亏害），与「冤郁」单向受冤义略有出入，属推断。

entries.zh: 冤陷：诬陷、构陷。agrauiar con engaño y traça＝用诡计奸谋加害，即设谋陷人于冤。
entries.en: to frame someone, to entrap by deceit and scheming (oan1-ham7)
